name: K-T2d
description: The diagnosis of the black own clouds of K-T2 start 42 (.local/plans/atmospheres/K-T2-black-clouds-diagnosis.md, 'One game start would settle the rest'). One start, the variant plain only, no timing, about 4 minutes of scenario (the limit is 8). Same pins and guards as K-T2 (raytracing Off, frame generation off, quality NativeAA, window 1707x960, no frame cap, EVE removed, weatherEffects/genEnabled/enabled on, the log guard, the pictures collected); no GPU profiler (its markers change the camera's buffers). The clock step emits the cover of all 48 candidate hours (T09.cover.<ut>) and picks two universal times with the sun at about the same height, both 30 to 55 degrees up (else both 15 to 60; T09d.sun_band_narrow, sun_band_min_deg / sun_band_max_deg, sun_elev_diff_deg): the hour with the lowest cover available ('low', band 0.2 to 0.4) and the hour nearest 0.7 (band 0.6 to 0.8, 'high') that is at least 0.15 above it; a pick outside its band is flagged by T09d.cover_off_band, and the start fails only where no pair is 0.15 apart (T09d.covers_distinct). At each, in the views ground (200 m, looking 18 degrees up) and above (8300 m, 25 degrees down), poses held (the vessel's centre of mass within 5 m of the point for 30 frames before each capture, 20 m at most at the read; expected: all frames pose_ok) and verified at every capture: the baseline frame (the pass runs with no layer drawn), cloud.sunGain 1, 4, 16 and 64 (one frame each, the sun colour of the pass read back and checked), and aid 4 (direct light, light taps, ambient as colours) at gain 1. Every frame is read as raw target values (no gamma step) and measured in three regions: the sky above the horizon (the horizon row from the camera's pitch and field of view), the sunlit sea or ground below it, and the deck (the pixels the pass changed against the baseline); the vessel's box is left out. Rows T09d.<view>.<cover>.<gain>.<stat> with sky_/ground_/deck_ n, p10, median, p90, r, g, b, clipped; deck_fraction; peak; the ratios deck_over_off_sky, deck_over_off_ground (the white reference: the sunlit sea of the baseline), sky_over_off_sky, ground_over_off_ground, deck_vs_g1 (gain 4, 16, 64 over gain 1). The light and the target are logged at the first drawn frame and every 30 s ('T09d env <key>: ...': Sun.Instance.sunLight and the other directional lights, the frame's sun colour and direction with its elevation, the ambient mode and values, Scatterer, SunAirHeightM, allowHDR, the camera target's format, the colour space, the camera's distance from the planet's centre against the vessel's altitude, the composition, the command buffers on the camera and its components); the first set is also in rows T09d.env.<key>. Pictures: half size, t09-diag1707-<view>_<cover>-<gain>-1707x960-natural-half.png (aid: -aid-direct-half). EXPECTED RESULTS, written before the run (values are raw luminance of the camera target; start 42 at cover 0.514 measured the ground sky at median 0.020, p90 0.063, the cloud areas from above at 0.118 next to a sea of 0.72, the baseline sky at 0.31 / 0.49 / 0.69; the offline raw value of the Player at sun 0.844 to 1.0 is 0.063 to 0.083 on the ground and 0.17 to 0.20 from above). PREDICTION A, units or composition is the cause and nothing after the pass clamps or darkens: the deck median rises in proportion to the gain until the target clips at 1.0 (ground view, high cover: gain 1 about 0.02 to 0.08, gain 4 about 0.08 to 0.32, gain 16 about 0.32 to 1.3 and clipped at 1.0 where the target is not HDR, gain 64 clipped at 1.0; deck_vs_g1 at gain 4 is 3.2 to 4.4; deck_over_off_sky climbs from 0.04 to 0.15 at gain 1 through the sky's level (1.0) at a gain of 6 to 25; above view: gain 1 about 0.1 to 0.2, gain 4 about 0.4 to 0.8, gain 16 clipped), and the deck over the baseline sunlit sea at gain 1 is the factor the sun's unit is short by (start 42: 0.16 from above, 0.03 on the ground). PREDICTION B, something after the pass clamps, darkens or replaces the colour (an image effect, Scatterer's extinction, the composite not being rgb + dst x (1 - alpha), a different target): the deck median stays near its gain-1 value or saturates at a constant whatever the gain (deck_vs_g1 at gain 4 under 2, gain 16 about the same as gain 4, deck_over_off_sky at gain 16 under 0.2, the deck's peak does not follow the gain); the checks on the sun colour of the pass (it follows the gain) rule out a gain that never arrived. The aid 4 frame separates the two inside the pass: its direct light (r) at gain 1 should be of the order of the sun colour's luminance 0.844 times the transmittance (tenths) under A or B alike; a deck median 10 times below it points at what the pass does with the light or at what follows it, while a direct light as small as the deck points at the light the pass is given (the T09d env lines name the sun light, the ambient and the colour space). At the low cover (about 0.3) the deck is broken or absent (deck_fraction 0 to 0.5; no deck rows is a legitimate result), and the baseline shows the clear sky for the first time; the point of the second cover is the deck fraction and the sky_over_off_sky of a sky the pass leaves alone (1.0). A diagnosis always yields data: a pose that is not the view's (T09d.<view>.<cover>.placed_ok, <gain>.pose_ok, T09d.frames_pose_ok / frames_pose_bad) is flagged and the frame is read and saved anyway (kt2d.py leaves such frames out of the verdict); only a lost scene or a dead vessel ends the start. The cover scan reads 48 hourly and 110 far candidates (7800 s steps, 10 days); the product has no override of the cloud cover, so when no hour is under 0.4 the nearest is taken and T09d.cover_off_band is 1. START 44 FOUND (2026-11-12): prediction A; ground high deck median 0.0145 / 0.0584 / 0.219 / 0.755 at gain 1 / 4 / 16 / 64 next to a sky of 0.458 and a sunlit sea of 0.443 (sun 15.6 degrees up, sun colour luminance 0.415), proportional to the gain. THE FIX (CloudOutputStage): the pass is radiometric and Unity's legacy lights have no 1/pi, so the pass is given pi times the scene's sun colour (cloud.sunUnit, ambient untouched), and its radiance is encoded relative to the sun's display value W in the final composite, D = W (c * exposure / W) ^ (1 / gamma) (cloud.exposure 1, cloud.outputGamma 2.2; gamma 1 = off). CHANGED IN THIS SERIES: the gain ladder g1 g4 g16 g64 runs with the stage forced off (cloud.sunUnit 1, cloud.outputGamma 1), so its rows and verdict are start 44's; after it, per view and cover, three more frames at gain 1: u1 (sun unit pi, no gamma), p1 (the product's defaults), pe2 (the product's stage at exposure 2); and rows T09d.<view>.<cover>.layer<l>_map_cover / _map_type, the pass's own map values at the site per layer (the cover the series picks is the field's at 3 km; the rain deck reads its map at its mid height). EXPECTED FOR THE STAGE, written before the start (ground view, high cover, same pick as start 44: raw deck 0.0145 at gain 1, sea 0.443, sky 0.458): u1 deck median 0.0456 (u1 / g1 = pi, 3.0 to 3.3; deck over the sea 0.10); p1 deck median 0.152 (0.12 to 0.19), p1 over the sea 0.34 (0.27 to 0.43), over the sky 0.33 (0.27 to 0.40): well below the sea, as a thick base lit by diffuse light is, and no longer 3 percent of it; pe2 deck median 0.208, pe2 / p1 = 2 ^ (1 / 2.2) = 1.37 (1.30 to 1.40). Above view, high cover (raw deck 0.311 = ambient about 0.20 in display units + direct about 0.11; sea 0.432): u1 about 0.55 (u1 / g1 1.5 to 2.6 because the ambient is not scaled), p1 about 0.47 (0.35 to 0.60), p1 over the sea 1.1 (0.8 to 1.4: a cloud top is about as bright as the sunlit sea). Not changed by the stage: the sea and the sky (ground_over_off_ground and sky_over_off_sky 1.0), the aid frame (the stage skips aid views; its direct light is pi times start 44's because the sun colour is). The stage's expected numbers are checked in tests/ReDefinition.Tests/Atmospheres/T09/CloudOutputStageTests.cs and tools/weather_metrics/kt2d.py (stage.* rows, stage.verdict 1 = inside the bands). EXPECTED FOR THE COVER MAP (CloudCoverModel, same test file): a map value of 0.473 under the rain deck (coverage 0.5, edge 0.2, noise amount 0.3) closes more than 60 percent of the sky for the Stratus type at 18 degrees up and at the zenith, 0.3 closes under 45 percent, 0.6 closes over 95 percent: the closed share is a ramp 0.3 wide in the map value, centred where the coverage threshold puts it (0.41 to 0.43 for half the sky at map 0.5, the file has 0.5); layer<l>_map_cover tells which value the shape actually saw. Measured in the same package; the result is read from the rows, no constant is fitted. Run: python tools/atmo_series.py run K-T2d --who <name> (preflight first: python tools/atmo_series.py preflight K-T2d).

starts.description: the own pass at 1707x960 with EVE removed: two covers, views ground and above, baseline, gains 1, 4, 16, 64 and aid 4; about 4 minutes of scenario
